newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares close down on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares close down on correction.

text.p: Shanghai B shares closed down on Thursday on a technical correction after sharp rises in the past few days, but market sentiment remained strong, with trading active, brokers said.
The index shed 0.941 points or 1.44 percent to 64.191 points, on volume of 46.3 million shares worth $21.3 million. All 42 B shares traded, with 24 down, six flat and 12 up.

"Profit-taking selling mainly came from domestic investors who had bought around the 50-point level," one broker said. "But overseas institutions continued to build positions, with their buying beginning from the 60-point level."
"The index will consolidate around 62-65 points for a while and the next bull run will begin next week, with most shares prices remaining low," a second broker said.
Shanghai Jintai was the biggest loser on profit-taking, down $0.018 or 9.57 percent to $0.170, on volume of 792,000 shares.
Shanghai Tyre & Rubber fell for the same reason, down $0.036 or 7.72 percent to $0.430, on volume of 556,800 million shares.
Eastern Communications was the most active stock on trading among institutions, falling $0.008 or 0.94 percent to $0.840, on volume of 6.1 million shares.
Shanghai A shares jumped in active trade, with a strong inflow of fresh capital, and the market is expected to maintain its strong sentiment in the short term, brokers said.

The A index ended up 45.791 points or 3.73 percent to 1273.717 points, on volume of 1.8 billion shares worth 18.8 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index soared 152.810 points or 5.41 percent to 2974.976 points.
Shanghai First Provision was the star on institutional buying, surging 1.90 yuan or 17.30 percent to 12.88 yuan, on volume of 5.7 million shares.
